_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. biosites.com declares no custom properties in its stylesheets, so the whole palette is measured: the monochrome inks and greys, the slate persona-card surface, the alpha scrims and the UA focus ring, each with the component+state it was read from. The site paints one light theme; the black hero and marquee bands live inside it.

250.source: entered by hand at capture time, not a committed reading: the body backgroundColor on /editor (the claim screen) as read off the page; raw/components-computed.json holds no body or /editor ground

navpill-hover.description: The nav pill's black fill on hover.

cta-hover.description: The CTA's white fill on hover.

claim-submit-bg.description: The circular claim submit's grey fill.

login-pill.description: The Log In pill on the claim screen.
